잠언-19-1.title: 잠언 19장 1절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-19-1.exegesis: 24. A man ... friendly-- better, "A man ... (is) to, or, may triumph ( Psa 108:9 ), or, shout for joy ( Psa 5:11 ), that is, may congratulate himself." Indeed, there is a Friend who is better than a brother; such is the "Friend of sinners" [Mt 11:19; Lu 7:34], who may have been before the writer's mind.
잠언-19-1.theologicalNote: 24. A man ... friendly-- better, "A man ... (is) to, or, may triumph ( Psa 108:9 ), or, shout for joy ( Psa 5:11 ), that is, may congratulate himself." Indeed, there is a Friend who is better than a brother; such is the "Friend of sinners" [Mt 11:19; Lu 7:34], who may have been before the writer's mind.

잠언-19-14.title: 잠언 19장 14절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-19-14.exegesis: 13. calamity-- literally, "calamities," varied and many. continual dropping-- a perpetual annoyance, wearing out patience.

잠언-19-15.title: 잠언 19장 15절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-19-15.exegesis: 14. A contrast of men's gifts and God's, who, though author of both blessings, confers the latter by His more special providence. and-- or, "but," implying that the evils of Pr 19:13 are only avoided by His care.

잠언-19-16.exegesis: 15. a deep sleep-- a state of utter indifference. idle soul-- or, "person" (compare Pr 10:4 ; 12:24 ).

잠언-19-17.exegesis: 16. (Compare Pr 10:17 ; 13:13 ). despiseth ... ways-- opposed to keeping or observing, neglects ( Pr 16:17 ) (as unworthy of regard) his moral conduct.

잠언-19-21.exegesis: 20. (Compare Pr 13:18-20 ). latter end-- ( Pr 5:11 ). In youth prepare for age.
